links.outcome: Reading time with vs without AI labeling by radiologist type
links.effect: Reading times were reduced for residents (p < 0.05) but not for specialists; overall reading times did not differ significantly (p = 0.0858).
links.quote: Integrating an AI-assisted spine labeling algorithm into the PACS significantly reduced reading times for residents (p < 0.05) but not for specialists.

screen.reason: The study evaluates the impact of integrating an automated spine labeling AI tool directly into clinical PACS workflow on radiologist reading times and error rates across different experience levels.

primary.practice: PACS integration / AI assistance in daily workflow
